column1: # GitLab project -> GitHub repository copied by tools/sync-github-mirror.sh.
# Columns (TAB): name, gitlab path, github path, mode, options (key=value ...).
#   mode filter:   filtered copy (size limit, strip list, text list, mailmap).
#   mode identity: GitLab refs pushed unchanged after a guard scan.
#   trusted_base=<sha>[,...]  history imported unchanged from upstream, not re-read.
#   gh_only=<glob>[,...]      GitHub-only refs that are expected and kept.
#   prune_github_only=<glob>[,...]  GitHub-only refs approved for deletion by --prune.
